title: The Teacher of Physical Education
statementMd:
$*n*$ pupils came to Physical Education lesson. We know the name and the height of each pupil.

Your task is to help the teacher of Physical Education to line up all pupils in non-decreasing order of their heights.

## Input

The first line contains the positive integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$) — the number of pupils.

The next $*n*$ lines contain the pupils' description. In the $*i*$-th line there is pupil's name $*name*_{*i*}$ (a non-empty string which consists of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters, the length does not exceed five) and pupil's height $*x*_{*i*}$ ($130 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 215$). Some pupils can have the same name. Uppercase and lowercase letters of the alphabet should be considered different.

## Output

Print $*n*$ lines — pupils' names in the non-decreasing order of their heights. Each line must contain exactly one name.

If there are several answers, print any of them. Uppercase and lowercase letters of the alphabet should be considered different.
statementZhMd:
$*n*$ 名学生来上体育课。我们知道每名学生的姓名和身高。

你的任务是帮助体育老师按照身高非递减的顺序将所有学生排成一列。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个正整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$）——学生人数。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行包含学生的信息。第 $*i*$ 行包含学生的姓名 $*name*_{*i*}$（由大写和小写拉丁字母组成的非空字符串，长度不超过 5）以及学生的身高 $*x*_{*i*}$（$130 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 215$）。一些学生可能有相同的姓名。字母表中的大写字母和小写字母视为不同字符。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 行——按照身高非递减的顺序排列的学生姓名。每行必须恰好包含一个姓名。

如果有多种答案，输出任意一种即可。字母表中的大写字母和小写字母视为不同字符。
